claims: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket stands 322 feet (98 meters) tall when fully stacked with the Orion spacecraft.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket fully stacked with the Orion spacecraft is taller than the Statue of Liberty.
The total height is 322 feet (98.1--98.3 m).
The SLS rocket itself, including boosters, is ~322 ft.
The SLS rocket is about 7 feet taller than London's Big Ben.
The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II crew launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew launched aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket fully stacked with the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the Moon.
